title: Surfacing and Applying Meaning: Supporting Hermeneutical Autonomy for LGBTQ+ People in Taiwan

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation workshops where Taiwanese LGBTQ+ participants interacted with an LLM-powered prototype chatbot (Queerbot) using curated real-world discriminatory, stereotyped, and hostile social media posts to assess the system's ability to provide hermeneutical support, validation, and allyship.

Formative interviews and participatory design workshops evaluating how mainstream social media algorithms and Western-centric AI models cause hermeneutical injustice (epistemic marginalization) for non-Western (Taiwanese) marginalized users, measured through thematic analysis of user experiences.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
